note: Adapted from Maiti 2006; original in English; the original spells this subspecies Coptotermes reffrayi, and only the second half of the alate paragraph in the text (ocelli, pronotum, wings) survives, the first half is not present in that scan; the measurements are taken from Tables 7 and 26.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closest to the nominotypical subspecies C. acinaciformis acinaciformis, with nearly identical wing venation and body colour; soldier head nearly rectangular, longer than wide, distinctly narrowed anteriorly, fontanelle small, its opening with a chitinous ring, situated slightly below the posterior margin of the postclypeus. Maiti (2006) distinguishes the two by the smaller ocelli of the alate (0.11—0.16 mm) and the denser wing hairs, and by the longer soldier head and postmentum (head length 1.50—1.79 mm).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Maximum ocellus diameter 0.11—0.16 mm; pronotum narrower than the head or nearly as wide as the head, anterior margin slightly concave, posterior margin weakly concave at the middle; wings very similar to those of the nominotypical subspecies, sometimes more hairy. Measurements (mm): body length with wings 11.73—14.00; body length without wings 6.25—8.00; head length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.06—1.17; head width including the eyes 1.31—1.43; maximum eye diameter 0.29—0.36; maximum ocellus diameter 0.11—0.16; pronotum length 0.77—0.84, width 1.32—1.43; forewing length 9.25—9.50; antennae 17—20-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head light to dark brown, paler anteriorly, the remaining parts paler. Head and pronotum sparsely hairy, the abdomen especially the posterior half densely hairy. Head nearly rectangular, sides and posterior margin weakly convex, with a very weak constriction above the antennal sockets, longer than wide, distinctly narrowed anteriorly; fontanelle small, its opening with a chitinous ring, situated slightly below the posterior margin of the postclypeus. Measurements (mm): head length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.50—1.79; maximum head width 1.24—1.39; anterior head width 0.84—0.99; mandible length 1.03—1.10; postmentum midlength 1.00, maximum width 0.42, waist width 0.21—0.32; pronotum length 0.48—0.61, width 0.91—1.12; antennae 16-segmented.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The holotype is a soldier, in the Wasmann collection; morphotypes of the alate and worker are in the National Museum of Victoria, Melbourne. Distribution: several localities in Western Australia (Hill, 1942). The species name is spelled reffrayi in the body of this work.
